orgDesign.domainName: Engineering Information and Asset Lifecycle Platform
orgDesign.companyProfile: Proposed 73-person product/delivery organization plus six group leadership roles. This is a planning scenario, not Assai headcount; corporate sales, finance, HR and other company functions are excluded.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Eight teams each own a coherent set of bricks. Internal platform services support stream teams; customer-side engineering authorities, asset owners and system owners retain technical approval and operating accountability. AI-assisted matching is modeled as product functionality with human stewardship, not autonomous staff or decision authority.
